summary: VLLMValidationError validators (order, texts, params, the max_logprobs 128256>20 check) are exact. No pydantic field validation, so a missing messages field or a wrong-typed field aborts the run instead of giving a 400 Bad Request.

priority rides on the engine request and fcfs ignores it. The X-Vllm-Priority header isn't modeled. There are no ge/le bounds on priority/seed, so 2**63 gives 200 instead of 400. guided_json is ignored, but its warning_once isn't modeled.

The model card lacks created/parent/permission. No unknown-route 404. The 404 text for an unknown model is exact. system_fingerprint is absent. Corrections: created has second resolution; streaming content chunks omit the field (exclude_unset), they don't carry null.

Pooling routes give 404 on a generate-only model. /invocations dispatches on whether messages/prompt is present, not by validation: the embeddings body gives 'Cannot find suitable handler' instead of the escaping VLLMValidationError, and {prompt: 5} is routed to completions and aborts. The message lacks the list-repr quotes. No JSON decode error.
Background, previous-response checks and their order are exact. The response lacks incomplete_details and max_output_tokens. The GET and cancel routes drop param response_id in their on_error.

Texts are right, but fetch-image runs on rank0. There are no configs for --allowed-local-media-path or --allowed-media-domains. The HTTP 404 comes out as code vllm-unprocessable-entity-error with no parameter/value suffix (create-error-response passes status>=400 through). No fetch retry: 500 after 5 s instead of 3 attempts and about 110 s.

smart_resize and the token count (800, 576) are right on a direct call, but the chat path never expands image tokens: prompt_tokens 12. No prompt_tokens_details. Correction: created_cache_tokens is an int (the full-block prompt tokens cached), not null.

The tokenizer counts the full text, so the message says 10008/10001 tokens instead of 'at least 8193'. The id list and the Responses >= check are exact. truncate_prompt_tokens (its bound and the -1 truncation) isn't modeled. The 8k prompt needs max_cel_cost raised.
